title: Hausa Language Technologies in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: A Systematic Review of Resources, Applications, Challenges, and Research Gaps (corpus and protocol)
description: Complete machine-readable artifacts of a systematic review of Hausa language technology across the 2019-2026 neural and pre-trained model era: the per-record full-text screening and eligibility log for the 169 downloaded candidate papers in version 1 (169 screened to 153 verified Hausa studies and then filtered to 150 studies published in 2019-2026), the final 150-study inventory with per-study insights and bibliographic quality scores, a 41-resource catalogue (all 2019-2026), the fixed data-extraction form, study-selection flow counts, an evidence-to-gap matrix for gaps G1-G10, a claim audit log, and the LaTeX source of the review paper.
